g.text: One runtime per agent role; automatic balanced routing; role-isolated history; shared services; four manual jobs in one command.
UI routes to the selected role
BGE: bound batch concurrency, preserve interactive query capacity.
One command runs four jobs, validates the new release and activates it.
The previous version stays available for rollback.
Selected target (D167/D169). Every runtime / job boundary is a separate container.
GCS holds prepared documents and the authoritative release pointer; Qdrant holds the index.
Activate only a verified release; preserve the previous version for rollback.
